items.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022
items.q: The only jazz recording I had, it was Bing Crosby singing Christmas tunes.

ctx.x: Were your parents, did they contribute to your musical career? Did they want you or force you to take piano lessons?

Well my grandmother was a piano teacher so I think all — my brother, my cousins, we all went through her teaching. The only one who stuck with it was me. So that’s how it worked. But I have it, in a certain way, family, like a musical family. My dad plays some piano because his mother played piano. My mother, from her family’s side, her great grandfather was a director of an orchestra. And my mom played a little guitar. But I was lucky that I was surrounded by music. Unfortunately not really jazz because that was…
You know you said before we were recording that you’re really into holiday lights and perhaps that’s it, perhaps that planted —
